title: THE CAPTAIN'S CABIN // SHADOWS OF THE SILENCE
narrative: The Great Cabin of the Silence was black as pitch, save for the blue smoke drifting from an incense burner carved like a kraken's jaw. Euron stood over her, smelling of salt water, dark wine, and Valyrian steel. He stripped away her modest gown with one sharp pull of a dagger, leaving her shivering naked against the fur-strewn deck. 'You shall be my salt queen, little blossom,' Euron whispered, his black leather eye patch pressing against her wet cheek. When his heavy, ringed hands pinned her wrists and his body entered hers with brutal, rhythmic power, Falia wept tears of terror and feverish devotion. In the darkness, she felt the ancient eldritch magic of the deep sea pulsing through his blood.
resolvesPlotHole: How Euron Convinced Falia Flowers to Walk Aboard Unafraid
